verses.original: Διὸ ἀναπολόγητος εἶ ὦ ἄνθρωπε πᾶς ὁ κρίνων ἐν ᾧ γὰρ κρίνεις τὸν ἕτερον σεαυτὸν κατακρίνεις τὰ γὰρ αὐτὰ πράσσεις ὁ κρίνων
verses.transliteration: Dio anapologētos ei ō anthrōpe pas ho krinōn en hō gar krineis ton heteron seauton katakrineis ta gar auta prasseis ho krinōn
verses.literal: You therefore have no excuse you who pass judgment on another For on whatever grounds you judge the other you are condemning yourself because you who pass judgment do the same things
verses.literalPt: Por isso, és inescusável, ó homem, qualquer que julgas; pois no que julgas a outro, a ti mesmo te condenas; porque tu, que julgas, praticas as mesmas coisas.

verses.original: οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τὸ κρίμα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν κατὰ ἀλήθειαν ἐπὶ τοὺς τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντας
verses.transliteration: oidamen de hoti to krima tou Theou estin kata alētheian epi tous ta toiauta prassontas
verses.literal: And we know that - God’s judgment against those who do such things is based on truth
verses.literalPt: Sabemos que o juízo de Deus contra os que tais coisas praticam é segundo a verdade.

verses.original: λογίζῃ δὲ τοῦτο ὦ ἄνθρωπε ὁ κρίνων τοὺς τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντας καὶ ποιῶν αὐτά ὅτι σὺ ἐκφεύξῃ τὸ κρίμα τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: logizē de touto ō anthrōpe ho krinōn tous ta toiauta prassontas kai poiōn auta hoti sy ekpheuxē to krima tou Theou
verses.literal: So when you O man pass judgment on others . . . yet do the same things . . . do you think - you will escape - God’s judgment
verses.literalPt: Tu, ó homem, que julgas os que praticam tais coisas e fazes as mesmas, pensas que escaparás do juízo de Deus?

verses.original: ἢ τοῦ πλούτου τῆς χρηστότητος αὐτοῦ καὶ τῆς ἀνοχῆς καὶ τῆς μακροθυμίας καταφρονεῖς ἀγνοῶν ὅτι τὸ χρηστὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς μετάνοιάν σε ἄγει
verses.transliteration: ē tou ploutou tēs chrēstotētos autou kai tēs anochēs kai tēs makrothymias kataphroneis agnoōn hoti to chrēston tou Theou eis metanoian se agei
verses.literal: Or do you disregard the riches of His kindness - tolerance and patience not realizing that - God’s kindness leads you to repentance
verses.literalPt: Ou desprezas tu as riquezas da sua bondade, e tolerância, e longanimidade, ignorando que a bondade de Deus te conduz ao arrependimento?

verses.original: Κατὰ δὲ τὴν σκληρότητά σου καὶ ἀμετανόητον καρδίαν θησαυρίζεις σεαυτῷ ὀργὴν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς καὶ ἀποκαλύψεως δικαιοκρισίας τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kata de tēn sklērotēta sou kai ametanoēton kardian thēsaurizeis seautō orgēn en hēmera orgēs kai apokalypseōs dikaiokrisias tou Theou
verses.literal: But because of your hard and unrepentant heart you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of wrath when God’s righteous judgment will be revealed
verses.literalPt: Mas, conforme a tua dureza e coração impenitente, entesouras para ti ira no dia da ira e da revelação do justo juízo de Deus,

verses.original: ὃς Ἀποδώσει ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hos Apodōsei hekastō kata ta erga autou
verses.literal: God will repay each one according to his deeds
verses.literalPt: que retribuirá a cada um segundo as suas obras:

verses.original: τοῖς μὲν καθ’ ὑπομονὴν ἔργου ἀγαθοῦ δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ ἀφθαρσίαν ζητοῦσιν ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: tois men kath’ hypomonēn ergou agathou doxan kai timēn kai aphtharsian zētousin zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: To those who by perseverance in doing good seek glory honor and immortality He will give eternal life
verses.literalPt: dará a vida eterna aos que, perseverando em fazer o bem, buscam glória, honra e incorrupção;

verses.original: τοῖς δὲ ἐξ ἐριθείας καὶ ἀπειθοῦσι τῇ ἀληθείᾳ πειθομένοις δὲ τῇ ἀδικίᾳ ὀργὴ καὶ θυμός
verses.transliteration: tois de ex eritheias kai apeithousi tē alētheia peithomenois de tē adikia orgē kai thymos
verses.literal: But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow wickedness there will be wrath and anger
verses.literalPt: porém haverá ira e indignação para os que são facciosos e que não obedecem à verdade, mas obedecem à injustiça.

verses.original: θλῖψις καὶ στενοχωρία ἐπὶ πᾶσαν ψυχὴν ἀνθρώπου τοῦ κατεργαζομένου τὸ κακόν Ἰουδαίου τε πρῶτον καὶ Ἕλληνος
verses.transliteration: thlipsis kai stenochōria epi pasan psychēn anthrōpou tou katergazomenou to kakon Ioudaiou te prōton kai Hellēnos
verses.literal: There will be trouble and distress for every human being who does evil first for the Jew then for the Greek
verses.literalPt: A tribulação e a angústia virão sobre toda alma do homem que obra o mal, do judeu primeiro, depois do grego;

verses.original: δόξα δὲ καὶ τιμὴ καὶ εἰρήνη παντὶ τῷ ἐργαζομένῳ τὸ ἀγαθόν Ἰουδαίῳ τε πρῶτον καὶ Ἕλληνι
verses.transliteration: doxa de kai timē kai eirēnē panti tō ergazomenō to agathon Ioudaiō te prōton kai Hellēni
verses.literal: but glory honor and peace for everyone who does good first for the Jew then for the Greek
verses.literalPt: mas a glória, a honra e a paz sobre todo o que obra o bem, sobre o judeu primeiro e depois sobre o grego.

verses.original: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν προσωπολημψία παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: ou gar estin prosōpolēmpsia para tō Theō
verses.literal: For - God does not show . . . favoritism
verses.literalPt: Pois Deus não se deixa levar de respeitos humanos.

verses.original: Ὅσοι γὰρ ἀνόμως ἥμαρτον ἀνόμως καὶ ἀπολοῦνται καὶ ὅσοι ἐν νόμῳ ἥμαρτον διὰ νόμου κριθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Hosoi gar anomōs hēmarton anomōs kai apolountai kai hosoi en nomō hēmarton dia nomou krithēsontai
verses.literal: All who sin apart from the law will also perish apart from the law and all who sin under the law will be judged by the law
verses.literalPt: Todos os que sem lei pecaram sem lei também perecerão; e todos os que com lei pecaram, por lei serão julgados;

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ οἱ ἀκροαταὶ νόμου δίκαιοι παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ ἀλλ’ οἱ ποιηταὶ νόμου δικαιωθήσονται
verses.transliteration: ou gar hoi akroatai nomou dikaioi para tō Theō all’ hoi poiētai nomou dikaiōthēsontai
verses.literal: For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God but it is the doers of the law who will be declared righteous
verses.literalPt: não são justos diante de Deus os ouvidores de lei, mas serão justificados os observadores de lei

verses.original: Ὅταν γὰρ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ νόμον ἔχοντα φύσει τὰ τοῦ νόμου ποιῶσιν οὗτοι νόμον μὴ ἔχοντες ἑαυτοῖς εἰσιν νόμος
verses.transliteration: Hotan gar ethnē ta mē nomon echonta physei ta tou nomou poiōsin houtoi nomon mē echontes heautois eisin nomos
verses.literal: Indeed when Gentiles who do not have the law do by nature what the law requires they are a law to themselves even though they do not have the law
verses.literalPt: (Quando os gentios, que não têm lei, fazem por natureza as coisas da Lei, estes, não tendo lei, para si mesmos são lei;

verses.original: οἵτινες ἐνδείκνυνται τὸ ἔργον τοῦ νόμου γραπτὸν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν συμμαρτυρούσης αὐτῶν τῆς συνειδήσεως καὶ μεταξὺ ἀλλήλων τῶν λογισμῶν κατηγορούντων ἢ καὶ ἀπολογουμένων
verses.transliteration: hoitines endeiknyntai to ergon tou nomou grapton en tais kardiais autōn symmartyrousēs autōn tēs syneidēseōs kai metaxy allēlōn tōn logismōn katēgorountōn ē kai apologoumenōn
verses.literal: So they show that the work of the law is written on their hearts their consciences also bearing witness and their thoughts either accusing or defending them
verses.literalPt: os quais mostram a obra da Lei escrita no seu coração, dando a sua consciência disso testemunho, e entre si, acusando-os ou defendendo-os, seus raciocínios),

verses.original: ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ὅτε κρίνει ὁ Θεὸς τὰ κρυπτὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου διὰ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: en hē hēmera hote krinei ho Theos ta krypta tōn anthrōpōn kata to euangelion mou dia Christou Iēsou
verses.literal: on the day when God will judge men’s secrets through Christ Jesus as proclaimed by my gospel
verses.literalPt: no dia em que Deus, segundo o meu evangelho, há de julgar as coisas ocultas dos homens, por Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: Εἰ δὲ σὺ Ἰουδαῖος ἐπονομάζῃ καὶ ἐπαναπαύῃ νόμῳ καὶ καυχᾶσαι ἐν Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Ei de sy Ioudaios eponomazē kai epanapauē nomō kai kauchasai en Theō
verses.literal: Now you if you call yourself a Jew if you rely on the law and boast in God
verses.literalPt: Mas, se tu és chamado judeu, e repousas na lei, e te glorias em Deus,

verses.original: καὶ γινώσκεις τὸ θέλημα καὶ δοκιμάζεις τὰ διαφέροντα κατηχούμενος ἐκ τοῦ νόμου
verses.transliteration: kai ginōskeis to thelēma kai dokimazeis ta diapheronta katēchoumenos ek tou nomou
verses.literal: if you know His will and approve of what is superior because you are instructed by the law
verses.literalPt: e conheces a sua vontade, e aprovas as coisas excelentes, sendo instruído na Lei,

verses.original: πέποιθάς τε σεαυτὸν ὁδηγὸν εἶναι τυφλῶν φῶς τῶν ἐν σκότει
verses.transliteration: pepoithas te seauton hodēgon einai typhlōn phōs tōn en skotei
verses.literal: if you are convinced that you are a guide for the blind a light for those in darkness
verses.literalPt: e estás persuadido que tu és guia dos cegos, luz daqueles que estão em trevas,

verses.original: παιδευτὴν ἀφρόνων διδάσκαλον νηπίων ἔχοντα τὴν μόρφωσιν τῆς γνώσεως καὶ τῆς ἀληθείας ἐν τῷ νόμῳ
verses.transliteration: paideutēn aphronōn didaskalon nēpiōn echonta tēn morphōsin tēs gnōseōs kai tēs alētheias en tō nomō
verses.literal: an instructor of the foolish a teacher of infants because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth
verses.literalPt: instruidor dos ignorantes, mestre das crianças, tendo na Lei a forma da ciência e da verdade;

verses.original: ὁ οὖν διδάσκων ἕτερον σεαυτὸν οὐ διδάσκεις ὁ κηρύσσων μὴ κλέπτειν κλέπτεις
verses.transliteration: ho oun didaskōn heteron seauton ou didaskeis ho kēryssōn mē kleptein klepteis
verses.literal: you, then who teach others do you not teach yourself You who preach against stealing do you steal
verses.literalPt: tu, pois, que ensinas a outro, não te ensinas a ti mesmo? Tu, que pregas que não se deve furtar, furtas?

verses.original: ὁ λέγων μὴ μοιχεύειν μοιχεύεις ὁ βδελυσσόμενος τὰ εἴδωλα ἱεροσυλεῖς
verses.transliteration: ho legōn mē moicheuein moicheueis ho bdelyssomenos ta eidōla hierosyleis
verses.literal: You who forbid . . . adultery do you commit adultery You who abhor idols do you rob temples
verses.literalPt: Tu, que dizes que não se deve cometer adultério, o cometes?

verses.original: ὃς ἐν νόμῳ καυχᾶσαι διὰ τῆς παραβάσεως τοῦ νόμου τὸν Θεὸν ἀτιμάζεις
verses.transliteration: hos en nomō kauchasai dia tēs parabaseōs tou nomou ton Theon atimazeis
verses.literal: You who boast in the law do you dishonor God by breaking the law
verses.literalPt: Tu, que abominas ídolos, roubas os templos? Tu, que te glorias na Lei, desonras a Deus pela tua transgressão da Lei?

verses.original: τὸ γὰρ Ὄνομα τοῦ Θεοῦ δι’ ὑμᾶς βλασφημεῖται ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καθὼς γέγραπται
verses.transliteration: to gar Onoma tou Theou di’ hymas blasphēmeitai en tois ethnesin kathōs gegraptai
verses.literal: As it is written God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you
verses.literalPt: Pois é por vossa causa que o nome de Deus é blasfemado entre os gentios, como está escrito.

verses.original: Περιτομὴ μὲν γὰρ ὠφελεῖ ἐὰν νόμον πράσσῃς ἐὰν δὲ παραβάτης νόμου ᾖς ἡ περιτομή σου ἀκροβυστία γέγονεν
verses.transliteration: Peritomē men gar ōphelei ean nomon prassēs ean de parabatēs nomou ēs hē peritomē sou akrobystia gegonen
verses.literal: Circumcision has value if you observe the law but if you break the law your circumcision has become uncircumcision
verses.literalPt: A circuncisão, na verdade, aproveita, se guardares a Lei; mas, se fores transgressor da Lei, a tua circuncisão tem-se tornado em incircuncisão.

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν ἡ ἀκροβυστία τὰ δικαιώματα τοῦ νόμου φυλάσσῃ οὐχ ἡ ἀκροβυστία αὐτοῦ εἰς περιτομὴν λογισθήσεται
verses.transliteration: ean oun hē akrobystia ta dikaiōmata tou nomou phylassē ouch hē akrobystia autou eis peritomēn logisthēsetai
verses.literal: If a man who is not circumcised keeps the requirements of the law will not his uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision
verses.literalPt: Pois, se o incircunciso guardar as ordenanças da Lei, não será a sua incircuncisão reputada como circuncisão?

verses.original: καὶ κρινεῖ ἡ ἐκ φύσεως ἀκροβυστία τὸν νόμον τελοῦσα σὲ τὸν διὰ γράμματος καὶ περιτομῆς παραβάτην νόμου
verses.transliteration: kai krinei hē ek physeōs akrobystia ton nomon telousa se ton dia grammatos kai peritomēs parabatēn nomou
verses.literal: The one who is physically uncircumcised yet keeps the law will condemn you who even though you have the written code and circumcision are a lawbreaker . . .
verses.literalPt: E o que é por natureza incircunciso, cumprindo a Lei, julgará a ti, que, com a letra e com a circuncisão, és transgressor da Lei.

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ ὁ ἐν τῷ φανερῷ Ἰουδαῖός ἐστιν οὐδὲ ἡ ἐν τῷ φανερῷ ἐν σαρκὶ περιτομή
verses.transliteration: Ou gar ho en tō phanerō Ioudaios estin oude hē en tō phanerō en sarki peritomē
verses.literal: A man is not a Jew because he is one outwardly nor is circumcision only outward and physical
verses.literalPt: Não é judeu aquele que o é exteriormente, nem é circuncisão a que o é exteriormente na carne;

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὁ ἐν τῷ κρυπτῷ Ἰουδαῖος καὶ περιτομὴ καρδίας ἐν πνεύματι οὐ γράμματι οὗ ὁ ἔπαινος οὐκ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἀλλ’ ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: all’ ho en tō kryptō Ioudaios kai peritomē kardias en pneumati ou grammati hou ho epainos ouk ex anthrōpōn all’ ek tou Theou
verses.literal: No a man is a Jew because he is one inwardly and circumcision is a matter of the heart by the Spirit not by the written code Such a man’s praise does not come from men but from God
verses.literalPt: mas é judeu aquele que o é interiormente, e circuncisão é a do coração, no espírito e não na letra. O louvor de tal judeu não vem dos homens, mas de Deus.
